summary: ADR0096 section C records one reviewed finite envelope binding exact source, inputs, resources, ordered actions and write domains. Verified success permits conditional advance without repeated step approvals; distinct step clocks remain clipped to the immutable parent. Stop on failure, Unknown, input drift or budget exhaustion, with no automatic retry or renewed clock. Only closed verified derivations can feed later steps. Prove actual engine graphroot/runroot/temp/output/process isolation; original outcomes and old holds remain separate from current metadata. Early real credential/policy/workflow/runtime preflight and typed observations remain substantive. Runner, bake, registration and first consumer retain priority. Reusable builder and desktop preparation and source-bound artifact handoff do not establish native qualification. Source delivery and installed instruction/caller adoption stay distinct. Public coordination returns https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6398426496 and https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6398854743 record two completed finite source-delivery envelopes using the receiver owner existing capabilities: each retained a single apply, exact source and native readback, independent original-scope retirement and its original clock. These observations demonstrate the source-delivery path only; no native engine/bake/consumer acceptance or general economic saving follows. Restricted raw evidence remains in owner custody.
title: Finite delegated execution requires demonstrated isolation
